description: Na₆Cd₇S₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six CdS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with four CdS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.26 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form distorted NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra, edges with four NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six CdS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.16 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.05 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cd and five S atoms. Both Na-Cd bond lengths are 3.28 Å. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.78-2.91 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.26 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.34 Å. There are seven inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CdS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 28°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.59-2.62 Å. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CdS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 25°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.64 Å. In the third Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.65 Å. In the fourth Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with six CdS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 19°. There are three shorter (2.59 Å) and one longer (2.61 Å) Cd-S bond length. In the fifth Cd site, Cd is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted CdS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with four CdS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-56°. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.67 Å. In the sixth Cd site, Cd is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Cd-S bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.88 Å. In the seventh Cd site, Cd is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and four S atoms. There are three shorter (2.53 Å) and one longer (3.02 Å) Cd-S bond length. There are ten inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four Na and three Cd atoms to form distorted SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one SNa₃Cd₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na and three Cd atoms. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na and three Cd atoms. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four Na and three Cd atoms. In the fifth S site, S is bonded to three Na and two Cd atoms to form distorted SNa₃Cd₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₂ square pyramids, corners with four SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-64°. In the sixth S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Cd atoms to form SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₃Cd₂ square pyramid, corners with four SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with four SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra. In the seventh S site, S is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Cd atoms to form SNa₃Cd₂ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, corners with four SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 1°. In the eighth S site, S is bonded to three Na and three Cd atoms to form distorted SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra that share corners with four SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₂ square pyramids. In the ninth S site, S is bonded to two Na and three Cd atoms to form SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₂ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 57°. In the tenth S site, S is bonded to two Na and three Cd atoms to form SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent SNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, corners with four SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SNa₄Cd₃ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SNa₂Cd₃ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°.
